evals.prompt: Run solid-coding's refactor/audit mode over evals/files/fixture-no-tests/pricing.py and report findings. Do not apply any fix without asking first.
evals.expected_output: Discovery reports no recognized ecosystem verification tooling for this bare fixture (no package manifest, no CI config) and says so plainly rather than inventing a check. Analysis reports an SRP/SoC finding (process_order mixes persistence, business-rule application, and formatting) and an OCP finding (the type-keyed discount conditional). Both findings are independently verified (CONFIRMED or PLAUSIBLE, with reasoning citing call sites and the actual code). Because the fixture has no tests, the report proposes adding a characterization test before any refactor, or explicitly flags the missing safety net, rather than silently refactoring untested behavior.
expectations: Reports that no existing test/lint/build tooling was found for this fixture, without inventing a command to run
Identifies an SRP or Separation-of-Concerns violation in process_order citing the mixed persistence/business-rule/formatting responsibilities
Identifies an OCP violation in the type-keyed discount conditional
Each finding shows an independent verification step (a verdict of CONFIRMED, PLAUSIBLE, or REJECTED with reasoning), not just the raw reviewer output
Notes the absence of test coverage and proposes or asks about a characterization test rather than silently refactoring untested code
Does not apply any fix without asking first

Discovery output notes the GitHub Actions workflow file
